title: 😚 Kissing Face with Closed Eyes Emoji: A Tender Kiss
description: 😚 closes its eyes, blushes, and puckers up. It's the sincere, affectionate kiss among the kissing emojis. See what it means from partners and friends.
summary: The 😚 kissing face with closed eyes shows puckered lips, shut eyes, and blushing cheeks. It means a sincere, affectionate kiss: tender more than flirty. Partners, close friends, and family use it for goodnights, thank-yous, and fond goodbyes. It has no heart, but the blush makes its warmth clear.
meaning: People close their eyes for kisses that mean something, and that is the idea behind 😚. Where the heart-blowing face tosses a kiss across the room with a wink, this one leans in. The blush adds shyness and sincerity. It suits messages to someone you are truly fond of: “miss you already 😚.”

Its tone is gentle and somewhat innocent. There is little teasing or innuendo in it, which makes it popular for affection that is not romantic. Parents send it to children, friends send it after a favor, and it is common in messages about babies and pets, where it stands for a soft kiss on the head.

In a romantic context it reads as sweet. Someone who sends 😚 to a partner is expressing closeness and comfort. Early in dating it can be a bashful way to send a first kiss by text, less forward than 😘 because nothing about it is a performance. The closed eyes suggest the sender is a little vulnerable in offering it.

It gets used far less than 😘, and many people never touch it, so those who do often choose it on purpose for its softer mood. Like the other puckered faces, it is occasionally used for whistling or pouting, but the blush and shut eyes make those readings less natural here than with 😗.

contexts.label: In a relationship
contexts.body: A quiet, loving kiss, good for goodnight texts, messages during time apart, and thanks for something thoughtful. It conveys tenderness more than desire. Couples who use both tend to send 😘 for playful moments and 😚 when feeling sentimental or sleepy.

contexts.label: With friends and family
contexts.body: Common from mothers, grandmothers, and affectionate friends. It is the emoji version of a kiss on the cheek. In cultures and families where kisses are a routine greeting, it ends messages as naturally as “take care.” Nothing romantic is implied in these settings.

contexts.label: From a crush
contexts.body: A warm sign, delivered shyly. It suggests real fondness and some nerves. Because it is not a common default, a person who sends it has usually picked it deliberately. It is still wise to consider their style, since some people use kiss emojis with all their friends.

examples.text: Goodnight, see you in my dreams 😚
examples.meaning: A tender bedtime kiss for a partner.

examples.text: Give the baby a kiss from me 😚
examples.meaning: Sending a gentle kiss to a child through someone else.
Fond longing for someone who is away.

examples.text: Safe travels, text me when you're there 😚

combos.meaning: A loving kiss with no ambiguity.
A kiss and a hug; warm family-style affection.

confusedWith.difference: 😘 winks and blows a heart. It is lively, popular, and often flirtatious. 😚 has closed eyes and a blush with no heart, and feels quieter and more sincere. Choose 😘 for a playful kiss and 😚 for a tender one.
😙 has eyes curved into smiles and usually no blush. It looks cheerful and friendly, and is often used for whistling. 😚 has fully closed eyes and pink cheeks, which makes the kiss feel more heartfelt.
😗 keeps its eyes open and shows no blush. It is the most neutral kiss and frequently is not a kiss at all. 😚 is the most affectionate of the heartless kissing faces.

avoid: Don't send it to colleagues or acquaintances, where any kiss emoji is too intimate.
Avoid it with someone you are keeping at a distance, since its sincerity can be taken as real affection.
design: A yellow face with eyes closed, lips puckered, and pink or red blush on both cheeks. On some platforms the closed eyes are downward-curving lines; on others they resemble the tight > < squint, which can make the face look as if it is straining. Apple, Google, Samsung, and Microsoft all include the blush, the feature that sets it apart from 😗 and 😙.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 😚 and 😘?
faqs.a: 😘 winks and sends a heart; it is outgoing and can be flirty. 😚 closes its eyes and blushes; it is tender and a little shy. 😘 is much more common. 😚 is chosen for softer, more sincere moments.
It can be, and often is between partners. It is also used platonically by family and close friends as a gentle kiss on the cheek. The relationship between sender and receiver determines the meaning.

faqs.q: What does 😚 mean from a guy or a girl?
faqs.a: Affection offered sincerely. From a partner or someone you are dating, it is a sweet kiss. From a friend or relative, it is fondness. If someone new sends it, they likely feel warmly toward you and are being a bit bashful about it.

faqs.q: Why are the cheeks red on 😚?
faqs.a: The blush shows shyness and warmth, as when someone gives a kiss they mean. It is what separates this face from the plain kissing face and gives it its affectionate, slightly bashful character.
